title: docs(skills): name the objectui upload packages after the providers fold
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DRcxA4Y78HaWBtydhVvejsk)_
Fixes #30559

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:objectui 技能的 project-setup 指南里两处上传说明(provider 列表与决策矩阵)不再指向已退役的 `@object-ui/providers`,改为点名 `@object-ui/fields`、`@object-ui/data-objectstack` 与 `@object-ui/types`。
- 为什么改:PR #30550 把上传能力并入 fields 并退役 providers 包;客户 agent 按旧指南会装一个不再发版、也没有上传上下文的依赖。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,不动代码与契约;回滚即 revert 本 PR。为付令牌棘轮,删了故障排查里两条只适用于 monorepo 的提示(Turbo 缓存一节与「下游包要先 build dist」一行)。
- 先看:`skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` 的 L249 段与决策矩阵上传行;其次故障排查节的两处删除。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n "@object-ui/providers" -- skills/` 预期零命中;`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 预期该文件 2726/2727 绿。
- 需要你做的:批准并合并(`skills/**` 为 Tier H,人合)。

## What changes

- `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`, provider-stack list: `UploadProvider` / `useUpload` now come from `@object-ui/fields`; the ObjectStack storage adapter `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`; the `UploadAdapter` / `UploadOptions` / `UploadResult` contract from `@object-ui/types`, re-exported by `@object-ui/fields`.
- Decision matrix, uploads row: `+ @object-ui/fields (UploadProvider), @object-ui/data-objectstack (adapter)`.
- Token payment (same-file deletion, no ceiling move): the troubleshooting section drops the `### Turbo cache issues` block and the `Run pnpm build — downstream packages need built dist/ directories` line. Both are advice for working inside the ObjectUI monorepo, not for a third-party app that consumes published packages; nothing else in the guide or the objectui skill points to them (`grep -i turbo` over the guide, `SKILL.md` and `README.md`: 0 hits after the edit).
- One root changeset, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

Every name was read off `origin/main` b77c160a, not off the card: `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx` L5485 (`UploadProvider`, `useUpload`) and L5486 (re-export of `UploadAdapter`, `UploadOptions`, `UploadResult` from `@object-ui/types`); `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` L8024 (`createObjectStackUploadAdapter`); `ui/packages/types/src/index.ts` L498 (the contract). `ui/packages/providers` no longer exists on `main`. All three packages are published (no `private` flag). No other `skills/**` line names `@object-ui/providers`.

## Tests

Docs-only diff; no test pins changed behaviour, so no ablation.

<details><summary>Skills size readings (head 67b7dec4)</summary>

- Edited file: `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` 349 → 346 lines, 2718 → 2726 tokens (ceiling 2727, headroom 1).
- Whole package, sum of every `SKILL.md`: 4534 → 4534 lines (no `SKILL.md` touched).
- Bundle total (whole shipped tree, `check-skills-token-ratchet`): 226234 → 226242 tokens.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch asked that nothing else in the guide change; the two troubleshooting deletions are the token-ratchet payment. The seat accepted the Turbo block; the `dist/` line was needed for the last 3 tokens and is the same monorepo-only class.

Local subset at head 67b7dec4: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles 44 derived families: 43 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED. `pnpm lint` exit 0 (outside the derivation).

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, "57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings".
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: exit 0, Test Files 170 passed / 2 skipped, Tests 4970 passed / 2 skipped.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: NOT MEASURED, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3), the gate reads every package's built `dist/` and this worktree built only the closures the derived gates need; CI builds first.
- Every other derived family: exit 0.

</details>
